쉬몰케 카본은 1992년 독일 남부 보덴호 호숫가의 도시 콘스탄츠에서 기: Schmolke Carbon was founded in 1992 by mechanical engineer Stefan Schmolke in Konstanz, a city on the shore of Lake Constance in southern Germany. He raced from a young age with his brother Matthias, and in 1989, just before graduating, the two opened a high-end parts shop. That same year he wrote his diploma thesis on the theory of a carbon racing handlebar.
이듬해 실제로 탈 수 있는 카본 핸들바를 만들었고, 주문이 생산 능력을: The following year he built a carbon handlebar that could actually be ridden, and when orders outgrew what he could make, he founded the company in 1992. In 2001 Jan Ullrich finished second overall at the Tour de France on a Schmolke handlebar. More than 30 years on, Schmolke still chooses quality over volume and hands over assembly lines.

More layers, less weight.
More layers for less weight.
TLO는 The Lightest One, 가장 가벼운 것이라는 뜻으로 쉬: TLO stands for The Lightest One, Schmolke's top line. Schmolke first analyses the forces acting on each part by computer, then lays up prepreg differently, up to 23 layers where the load concentrates and as few as 7 where it is light. Unlike parts with uniform wall thickness, material goes only where it is needed, so the result is both light and strong.
표면에는 도장을 하지 않습니다. 무광 에폭시 마감은 페인트보다 흠집에 강: The surface is never painted. The matt epoxy finish resists scratches better than paint and adds no unnecessary weight. Choose between two weaves, the fabric-like 1K and the unidirectional UD, finished as the red and white Schmolke Edition, the Black Edition or the White Edition.
졸업 논문에서 시작된 첫 카본 로드 핸들바. 쉬몰케의 모든 제품은 이 한: The first carbon road handlebar, born from a diploma thesis. Every Schmolke product starts from this one bar.
프리프레그를 손으로 한 겹씩 감아 만듭니다. 힘이 지나가는 경로를 따라: Prepreg is wound by hand, one layer at a time. The number and direction of layers follow the path of the load.
페인트 대신 무광 에폭시. 카본의 결이 그대로 보이고, 도장의 무게와 흠: Matt epoxy instead of paint. The carbon weave shows through, without the weight of paint or the worry of chips.
로드와 그래블, MTB, 폴딩 바이크까지. 같은 기준으로 핸들바와 시트포: Road, gravel, MTB and folding bikes. Handlebars, seatposts, saddles and wheels made to the same standard.
슈테판 쉬몰케는 학생 시절 자전거 기술 분야의 권위자 한스크리스티안 스몰: As a student, Stefan Schmolke researched the carbon handlebar under Hans-Christian Smolik, a leading figure in bicycle technology. After graduating he worked at a design office and at the aerospace company EADS. Today he still develops, or leads the development of, most of Schmolke's carbon components.
2020년부터는 같은 독일의 카본 컴포넌트 회사 THM과 함께합니다. 쉬: Since 2020 Schmolke has worked alongside THM, a fellow German carbon component maker. Schmolke's Leggerissima TLO pairs a THM Clavicula crankset with a Schmolke cockpit, seatpost, saddle and wheels for a complete bike of 5.4kg.
From handlebars to bottle cages, Schmolke's core parts made to the same principle.

쉬몰케의 출발점이 핸들바였던 만큼, 콕핏은 가장 오래 다듬어 온 영역입니: Schmolke began with a handlebar, so the cockpit is the area it has refined the longest. The Roadbar Evo TLO is hand-wound from up to 17 prepreg layers in the heavily loaded centre and 5 in the lower curve, for high stiffness at around 130g. It adds a shape that lets the hands rest easily, 10mm of trim at each end and optional internal cable ports.
2026년에는 핸들바와 스템을 하나로 합친 로드바 콕핏 TLO와 콕핏 에: In 2026 Schmolke introduced the Roadbar Cockpit TLO and Cockpit Aero TLO, merging bar and stem into one piece. The cables disappear inside the bar and stem, and the flattened tops give the palms a broad, comfortable grip.
가운데 최대 17겹, 아래 곡선부 5겹. 힘이 몰리는 곳과 그렇지 않은: Up to 17 layers in the centre, 5 in the lower curve. Varying the layer count between loaded and unloaded areas takes weight out.
알루미늄 너트를 반원형 판으로 받치는 대신, 카본 섬유가 인서트를 완전히: Instead of backing the aluminium nuts with a half-round plate, the carbon fibres wrap fully around the inserts. No creaking, even at low torque.
콕핏은 케이블을 완전히 숨기고, 에보 TLO와 TLO 스템도 내장 케이블: The cockpits hide the cables completely, and the Evo TLO and TLO Stem can be ordered with internal cable ports. The added weight is around 4g.
이렇게 가벼우면서도 쉬몰케의 핸들바와 스템, 콕핏은 최대 110kg까지: Light as they are, Schmolke handlebars, stems and cockpits are tested and approved up to 110kg.
쉬몰케의 기준이 되는 카본 드롭 핸들바. 1K 또는 UD 결, 세 가지: Schmolke's benchmark carbon drop bar. Choose 1K or UD weave, three logo editions, and options for internal routing and time trial clip-on reinforcement.
에보 TLO와 같은 리치와 드롭에 스템을 하나로 합친 일체형 콕핏. 브레: Integrated cockpit with the same reach and drop as the Evo TLO, stem included. Cables run through ports on each side at brake-lever height and through the centre of the stem.
드롭 앞쪽을 거의 수평으로 만들어 브레이크 레버와 손목이 일직선이 됩니다: The front of the drops is nearly horizontal, lining the brake levers up with the wrists. Time trial bars cannot be fitted.
모든 쉬몰케 핸들바의 짝: The partner for every Schmolke bar
TLO 스템은 80, 100, 110, 120mm 길이에 ±6° 각도,: The TLO Stem comes in 80, 100, 110 and 120mm lengths at ±6°, with a 31.8mm bar clamp and a 1-1/8 inch steerer. The 100mm weighs 86g, with M4 titanium bolts. It is left as unpainted 1K carbon.
모든 길이에 내장 케이블 구멍이 있고, 80mm는 로드뿐 아니라 그래블과: Every length has internal cable ports, and the 80mm is approved for gravel and MTB as well as road. The 100 to 120mm lengths are road only. The steerer clamp height is 40mm.
콕핏 에어로 TLO는 6° 플레어로 공기를 덜 받으면서도 지나치게 낮지: The Cockpit Aero TLO uses a 6° flare to cheat the wind with a position that is not too low. The front of the drops is shaped nearly horizontal, so on the hoods the wrists line up with the brake levers.
Stem lengths of 100, 110 and 120mm, 40mm stack, -6°. With bar and stem in one piece, there is no need to thread the cables through the bar separately.
프리프레그 핸드 와인딩, 가운데 최대 17겹, 아래 곡선부 5겹: Hand-wound prepreg, up to 17 layers in the centre, 5 in the lower curve
옵션, 구멍 3개 (양쪽 후드 높이 안쪽, 드롭 가운데), 약 4g 추가: Optional, 3 ports (inside the curves at hood height, centre of the drop), about 4g extra

쉬몰케 시트포스트는 무게만큼 유연함으로 알려져 있습니다. 2012년 독일: Schmolke seatposts are known as much for their flex as for their weight. In RennRad magazine's 2012 comparison of comfort seatposts, the TLO and SL took the test victory with the greatest flex, and in 2022 Roadbike magazine's carbon seatpost test ranked Schmolke first again.
하중이 큰 곳에는 최대 23겹, 적은 곳에는 7겹을 쌓아 앞뒤로는 부드럽: Up to 23 layers where the load is high and 7 where it is low let the post flex softly fore and aft while keeping lateral and torsional stiffness. The head clamps the rails at four points and holds round rails and oval carbon rails up to 8 x 12mm without an adapter. A Di2 battery fits inside.
쉬몰케의 기준 시트포스트. 1K와 UD 결, 세 가지 로고 에디션에서 고: Schmolke's benchmark seatpost. Choose 1K or UD weave and one of three logo editions. UD is a few grams heavier than 1K.
10mm 셋백의 TLO. 같은 적층에 헤드만 뒤로 물려, 안장을 조금 더: The TLO with 10mm of setback. The same layup with the head moved back, for riders who want the saddle a little further back.
TLO와 같은 방식으로 손으로 감아 만든 SL 라인. 6mm 티타늄 볼트: The SL line, hand-wound the same way as the TLO. Finished with 6mm titanium bolts, 1K weave and red and white logos.
시트포스트는 프레임 위로 나오는 길이(프레임 끝에서 안장 레일 가운데까지: Choose the length by measuring how much post shows above the frame (from the top of the frame to the centre of the saddle rails). For example, 170mm exposed suits a 280mm post. Because wall thickness varies along the post, Schmolke seatposts must not be cut, and should not be bought long and shortened.
TLO 55는 쉘과 프레임, 레일까지 한 조각의 카본으로 만든 안장입니다: The TLO 55 is a saddle made from a single piece of carbon, shell, frame and rails included. It weighs 55g, just as the name says. Instead of padding, the carbon shell flexes to support the rider. In its TLO saddle test, Germany's TOUR magazine found that the centre and wings of the shell flex visibly, making it more comfortable than it looks.
SL 79는 폭 130mm로 로드와 그래블, 크로스컨트리까지 쓰는 3K: The SL 79 is a 130mm-wide 3K carbon saddle for road, gravel and cross-country. The SL 99 and SL 109 add a leather or non-leather cover to a carbon shell, for riders who want a touch of cushioning with their light weight.
프레임과 레일이 하나로 이어진 풀카본 안장. 블랙 에디션, 팀 에디션,: A full carbon saddle with frame and rails in one piece. Available as Black Edition, Team Edition and red and white.
조금 더 넓고 긴 3K 카본 안장. 장거리와 그래블에서도 TLO 시트포스: A slightly wider and longer 3K carbon saddle. With a TLO seatpost it makes the lightest pairing for long rides and gravel too.
카본 쉘에 가죽(SL 99, SL 109) 또는 논레더(SL 109) 커: Saddles with a leather (SL 99, SL 109) or non-leather (SL 109) cover over a carbon shell. The softest of Schmolke's saddles.
쉬몰케 휠은 복잡한 일체 성형 대신 아주 가벼운 부품을 하나씩 손으로 엮: Instead of complex one-piece moulding, Schmolke wheels are built the traditional way, lacing very light parts together by hand. Rims laid up by hand from thin, circularly woven prepreg are paired with 24 carbon spokes with titanium end pieces and Extralite or NONPLUS hubs.
TLO 37 2세대는 한 쌍 840g으로 오르막을 위한 휠셋이고, Roa: The second-generation TLO 37 weighs 840g a pair, a climbing wheelset that took first place in Roadbike magazine's test. The TLO 50 came in at 940g with 50mm rims, which BikeRadar called the lightest 50mm wheelset it had seen. For gravel there is the TLO Gravel PI ROPE, with textile spokes of 2.2g each.
2세대 TLO 37. 안쪽 폭 25mm의 훅 비대칭 림으로 25~32mm: The second-generation TLO 37. A hooked asymmetric rim with 25mm internal width suits 25 to 32mm tyres and runs tubeless. With DT Swiss 180 hubs it weighs 970g.
T1100 카본 림과 카본 스포크의 50mm 휠셋. 28~40mm 타이어: A 50mm wheelset with T1100 carbon rims and carbon spokes. Takes tyres up to 28 to 40mm, and can also be ordered with steel aero spokes.
고강도 폴리에스터 PI ROPE 스포크로 엮은 그래블 휠셋. 40~45m: A gravel wheelset laced with high-strength polyester PI ROPE spokes. 40 to 45mm tyres are recommended, and the spokes come in 11 colours.
UD 카본, 블랙 또는 화이트 로고: UD carbon, black or white logos
모든 휠셋은 디스크 브레이크, 앞 100mm · 뒤 142mm 12mm: All wheelsets are disc brake with 100mm front and 142mm rear 12mm thru-axles, and the freehub can be Shimano HG, SRAM XDR or Campagnolo. Each wheelset is built by hand in Germany after ordering, so lead times vary by specification. Please contact Rubi Workshop in advance.

폴딩 바이크는 시트포스트가 길게 드러나는 만큼 무게 차이도 큽니다. 50: Folding bikes leave a long stretch of seatpost exposed, so the weight difference is large. The 500 to 600mm TLO folding seatpost weighs 159g at 31.8 x 600mm, saving up to half the weight of a typical steel post. The 16 inch TLO carbon rim weighs 185g.

From a single diploma thesis
to the benchmark for the lightest parts.
한 공학도의 졸업 논문에서 나온 카본 핸들바가 투르 드 프랑스 시상대에: A carbon handlebar born from an engineering student's thesis reached the Tour de France podium, and some 30 years later became a 5.4kg complete bike. Rather than announcing new prototypes all the time, Schmolke has kept to delivering what it makes quickly and taking care over every single order.
대학 졸업을 앞둔 슈테판 쉬몰케가 형과 하이엔드 자전거 매장을 열고, 새: About to graduate, Stefan Schmolke opens a high-end bike shop with his brother and writes his diploma thesis on new materials and the theory of a carbon racing handlebar.
The year after the thesis, he builds the first rideable carbon road handlebar.
When handlebar orders outgrow his capacity, he founds Schmolke Carbon in Konstanz.
얀 울리히가 쉬몰케 핸들바로 투르 드 프랑스 종합 2위에 오릅니다. 품질: Jan Ullrich finishes second overall at the Tour de France on a Schmolke handlebar. In quality testing, the carbon bar proves stiffer and lighter than aluminium.
RennRad 매거진의 컴포트 시트포스트 비교 테스트에서 TLO와 SL이: In RennRad magazine's comparison test of comfort seatposts, the TLO and SL win with the greatest flex and the lowest weight.
같은 독일의 카본 컴포넌트 회사 THM과 함께하기 시작합니다. 두 회사는: Schmolke begins working alongside THM, a fellow German carbon component maker. Each company runs its own factory and team independently.
30주년을 맞아 카본 프레임과 완성차를 선보입니다. 에어로우(Aerrow: For its 30th anniversary, Schmolke introduces carbon frames and complete bikes. The Aerrow and the Infinity gravel bike begin here.
완성차 5.4kg의 레게리시마 TLO가 독일 TOUR 매거진 테스트에서: The 5.4kg Leggerissima TLO is recorded as the lightest road bike in Germany's TOUR magazine test.
핸들바와 스템을 하나로 합친 로드바 콕핏 TLO와 콕핏 에어로 TLO를: Schmolke introduces the Roadbar Cockpit TLO and Cockpit Aero TLO, merging bar and stem into one piece.
